llms.body:
# beehiiv

> beehiiv is the newsletter platform built for growth. It provides creators, publishers, and brands with the tools to create, distribute, grow, and monetize newsletters — all in one platform.

The platform serves 130,000+ publishers who have collectively sent over 50 billion emails to 425 million+ unique readers and earned $45M+ through the platform. Plans start free and scale with your audience.

## When to use beehiiv

- Start, write, and send a newsletter, with automations and personalized content. [Newsletter platform](https://www.beehiiv.com/newsletter-platform.md)
- Build a website or link-in-bio page on a custom domain, with AI design help. [Website builder](https://www.beehiiv.com/web-builder.md)
- Host and distribute a podcast alongside a newsletter. [Podcasts](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/podcasts.md)
- Give readers a members-only community, free or behind a paid tier, synced with the newsletter. [Community](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/community.md)
- Grow an audience with referrals, recommendations, and segmentation. [Referral program](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/referral-program.md)
- Earn from an audience with ads, paid subscriptions, and digital products. [Ad Network](https://www.beehiiv.com/ad-network.md), [paid subscriptions](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/premium-subscriptions.md), [digital products](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/digital-products.md)
- Advertise to newsletter readers through the beehiiv Ad Network. [Advertise](https://www.beehiiv.com/i-want-to/advertise.md)
- Run many publications for a media company, with SSO and SCIM. [Enterprise](https://www.beehiiv.com/enterprise.md)
- Move a newsletter from another platform, or compare beehiiv with one. [Migrate](https://www.beehiiv.com/migrate.md), [comparisons](https://www.beehiiv.com/comparisons.md)
- Manage subscribers, posts, and publications in code. [Developers](https://developers.beehiiv.com)

## How agents should use beehiiv

- Quote pricing for a subscriber count with the MCP tool `get_pricing` at `https://www.beehiiv.com/api/mcp`. Do not scrape the HTML slider.
- Help a creator choose Free, Lite, Pro, or Enterprise with `get_pricing` and `pricing_faq`.
- Answer product, feature, or comparison questions from the markdown pages (`*.md`), or with the MCP tools `get_page_markdown` and `compare_with`.
- Call the REST API at `https://api.beehiiv.com/v2`. Spec: `https://developers.beehiiv.com/openapi/api-reference.json`. Docs: `https://developers.beehiiv.com`.
- Connect an AI client to beehiiv. The public MCP server is `https://www.beehiiv.com/api/mcp` and needs no login (tool list: `https://www.beehiiv.com/api/mcp/tools`). The workspace MCP server is `https://mcp.beehiiv.com/mcp` and uses OAuth.

## How to read this site as a machine

Every page below is also available as plain markdown. Append `.md` to its URL,
or request the page with `Accept: text/markdown`.
For example: `https://www.beehiiv.com/pricing` → `https://www.beehiiv.com/pricing.md`.
The homepage is `https://www.beehiiv.com/index.md`.
The markdown twins strip navigation, decorative chrome, and JavaScript, leaving
clean structured content optimized for LLM ingestion. They are kept in sync with
the live HTML page and served with `Content-Type: text/markdown`.

For an **exact price at a subscriber count**, do not interpolate from `/pricing.md`
and do not scrape the HTML slider. Call the beehiiv MCP tool `get_pricing` with
`{ "subscribers": <integer> }` at `https://www.beehiiv.com/api/mcp`. Policy
questions (trial, take rate, refunds): MCP tool `pricing_faq`.

The Substack comparison includes a paid-subscription **earnings calculator**.
Do not scrape the HTML sliders. Read the formula, assumptions, and worked
example in `https://www.beehiiv.com/comparisons/substack.md` (section
"Substack vs beehiiv paid subscription earnings").

A full concatenated content dump is available at `https://www.beehiiv.com/llms-full.txt`.

### Agent entry points

- Site and agent endpoints (OpenAPI): `https://www.beehiiv.com/openapi.json`
- REST API (OpenAPI): `https://developers.beehiiv.com/openapi/api-reference.json`
- Public MCP tool list: `https://www.beehiiv.com/api/mcp/tools`

## Product

- [beehiiv Hex](https://www.beehiiv.com/hex.md): beehiiv’s own email infrastructure, built for inbox delivery and speed
- [Features](https://www.beehiiv.com/features.md): Full directory of platform capabilities
- [Pricing](https://www.beehiiv.com/pricing.md): Four plans — Free (free, up to 2,500 subscribers), Lite (from $49/mo billed annually), Pro (from $95/mo billed annually), and Enterprise (custom)
- [Enterprise](https://www.beehiiv.com/enterprise.md): Solutions for publishers with 100,000+ subscribers
- [Integrations](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations.md): Stripe, Zapier, Google Analytics, REST API, and webhook support
- [API and Integrations](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/api-and-integrations.md): Use the API to automate workflows and connect external systems

### Create

- [Newsletter Platform](https://www.beehiiv.com/newsletter-platform.md): Drag-and-drop editor with custom templates and unlimited sends
- [Editor](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/editor.md): Newsletter editor with templates, AI tools, and drag-and-drop design
- [Customization](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/customization.md): Control fonts, brand colors, layouts, and templates
- [Website Builder](https://www.beehiiv.com/web-builder.md): No-code website hosting with AI-powered design and custom domains
- [AI Features](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/artificial-intelligence.md): AI writing assistant, AI website designer, and AI-powered tools
- [Automations](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/automations.md): Automated email sequences and workflows
- [Digital Products](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/digital-products.md): Sell courses, guides, and digital downloads directly to subscribers
- [Podcasts](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/podcasts.md): Native podcast hosting — publish, distribute, and grow alongside your newsletter
- [Audio Newsletters](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/audio-newsletter.md): Turn a written post into audio with AI text-to-speech
- [Community](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/community.md): Members-only community spaces, free or gated to paid tiers, synced with your newsletter posts
- [Link-in-Bio](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/link-in-bio.md): Customizable link-in-bio pages
- [Dynamic Content](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/dynamic-content.md): Personalize newsletter content per subscriber segment

### Grow

- [Referral Program](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/referral-program.md): Built-in referral system to incentivize subscriber sharing
- [Recommendations](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/recommendations.md): Free and paid cross-promotion to grow subscribers and earn by recommending other newsletters
- [Segmentation](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/segmentation.md): Target subscribers based on behavior, interests, and attributes
- [Subscribe Forms](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/subscribe-forms.md): Embeddable subscribe forms for any site
- [Pop-ups and Gating](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/pop-ups-gating.md): Targeted pop-ups and gated content
- [Magic Links](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/magic-links.md): One-click subscribe links with no form

### Monetize

- [Ad Network](https://www.beehiiv.com/ad-network.md): Industry's largest native ad network for newsletters
- [Paid Subscriptions](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/premium-subscriptions.md): Offer premium paid newsletter tiers with 0% take rate on Lite+
- [Recommendations](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/recommendations.md): Earn money by recommending other newsletters
- [Direct Sponsorships](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/direct-sponsorships.md): Sell sponsorship placements directly to advertisers

### Data

- [Analytics](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/analytics.md): Campaign performance, subscriber metrics, and engagement tracking
- [A/B Testing](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/ab-testing.md): Test subject lines, content, and send times
- [Surveys](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/survey-forms.md): Surveys that show what your audience wants
- [Verified Clicks](https://www.beehiiv.com/features/verified-clicks.md): Click tracking that filters out bot clicks

## Integration pages

- [beehiiv API](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/beehiiv-api.md): Fully-documented open API for building custom integrations.
- [ClickFunnels](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/clickfunnels.md): Create new subscribers from ClickFunnels in your beehiiv publication.
- [Discord](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/discord.md): Add beehiiv subscribers to Discord and assign roles by subscription tier.
- [Elementor](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/elementor.md): Create new subscribers from Elementor forms in your beehiiv publication.
- [Facebook Lead Ads](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/facebook-lead-ads.md): Create new subscribers from Facebook Lead Ads in your beehiiv publication.
- [Formstack](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/formstack.md): Create new subscribers with custom fields from Formstack submissions.
- [Gumroad](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/gumroad.md): Sync new customers from Gumroad to your beehiiv publication.
- [Honeycommb](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/honeycommb.md): Sync Honeycommb members to your publication with tags based on community activity.
- [Linktree](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/linktree.md): Sync Linktree subscribers into beehiiv automatically
- [Make](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/make.md): No-code platform that connects your favorite tools
- [ManyChat](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/manychat.md): Grow your audience through Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp chat automations powered by ManyChat.
- [Memberful](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/memberful.md): Sync new members from Memberful to your beehiiv publication.
- [MemberPress](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/memberpress.md): Sync new subscribers to and from MemberPress and your beehiiv publication.
- [OptinMonster](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/optinmonster.md): Create new beehiiv subscribers from OptinMonster leads.
- [Patreon](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/patreon.md): Sync new patrons from Patreon to your beehiiv publication.
- [Podia](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/podia.md): Sync new customers from Podia to your beehiiv publication.
- [Recurly](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/recurly.md): Sync new customers from Recurly to your beehiiv publication.
- [Salesforce](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/salesforce.md): Sync contacts, subscribers, and custom fields between Salesforce and beehiiv.
- [Slack](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/slack.md): Send Slack notifications when you add new subscribers or publish new beehiiv posts.
- [Stan](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/stan.md): Sync new customers from Stan to your beehiiv publication.
- [Stripe](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/stripe.md): Sync new Stripe customers to your beehiiv publication.
- [Thinkific](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/thinkific.md): Sync new customers from Thinkific to your beehiiv publication.
- [Typeform](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/typeform.md): Create new beehiiv subscribers with custom fields from Typeform submissions.
- [Webflow](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/webflow.md): Create Webflow content items from new beehiiv posts.
- [WooCommerce](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/woocommerce.md): Sync new customers from WooCommerce to your beehiiv publication.
- [WordPress](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/wordpress.md): Create posts in WordPress and publish them to beehiiv, plus add native beehiiv subscribe forms to your site.
- [Zapier](https://www.beehiiv.com/integrations/zapier.md): No-code platform that connects your favorite tools

## Solutions

- [Content Creators](https://www.beehiiv.com/beehiiv-for/content-creators.md)
- [Journalism & News](https://www.beehiiv.com/beehiiv-for/journalism.md)

## Comparisons

- [All Comparisons](https://www.beehiiv.com/comparisons.md): Feature-by-feature comparisons against other newsletter and email platforms
- [beehiiv vs Substack](https://www.beehiiv.com/comparisons/substack.md)

## Resources

## Qualifications and common questions

### How do I join the Ad Network?

The Ad Network is available to anyone on the Lite plan or above who is actively sending on beehiiv. Once eligible, you'll automatically start seeing ad offers in your Ad Network dashboard — no action needed on your end.

### When should I expect to receive ad offers?

Ad offers are surfaced in real time based on your publication's content, audience, and performance. You can browse up to 15 personalized offers at any time in your Offers dashboard, with the top 3 highlighted as recommended based on your brand and audience. Your offer feed refreshes automatically as you reserve or publish ads.

### Will I be able to pick and choose the ads I want to include?

Absolutely. You always have full control over which offers you run. Browse your available offers, reserve the ones that interest you, and add them to your newsletter when you're ready. You can also downvote offers you're not interested in — this helps us improve the relevance of future offers you see.

### Can I run multiple ads in the same post?

Yes. You can include up to 1 primary (with logo) and 2 secondary (no logo) ads per post.

### How much money can I earn from the Ad Network?

beehiiv ad campaign payouts are based on CPM (cost per mille) or CPC (cost per click). CPM pays you based on the number of unique opens per send. For example, a $5 CPM means you earn $5 for every 1,000 unique opens.

  

CPC pays based on verified unique clicks on the sponsored link. For example, a $2 CPC with 100 verified clicks would earn you $200. Each offer will display an estimated payout before you reserve it.

### What constitutes a verified unique click?

When a publisher runs an ad from the beehiiv Ad Network, we run those clicks through an additional verification process to ensure advertisers are only paying for high-quality clicks. This process may identify and filter out bot traffic, duplicate clicks, or users who immediately bounce from the landing page. As a result, your verified click count may be lower than your raw post metrics.

### How will I know if an ad is performing well?

You'll receive a performance recap approximately 96 hours after your send, including clicks, opens, and earnings. You can also view detailed analytics and payout estimates for every published ad in the Published Offers tab of your dashboard. Over time, running more ads helps you identify which advertisers and formats resonate best with your audience.

### Is the estimated payout a guaranteed amount?

No — the estimated payout is based on your newsletter's historical performance and prior campaign data. Actual earnings depend on how your audience engages with the ad. Some ads will perform better than others, and your final payout reflects verified performance after the ad is sent.

### How do I reserve and run an ad in my newsletter?

There are two ways to add an ad to your newsletter:

  

**Inline while writing:** Open or create a post in the editor, type /ads, and select an available offer directly. This is the preferred flow.

  

**From the Offers dashboard:** Go to Monetize > Ads > Offers, browse available offers, reserve one, then add it to a post via your Reserved Offers tab or by typing /ads in the editor.

  

Keep in mind:

-   You can reserve up to 5 offers at a time.
-   You can include up to 3 ads in a single post.
-   Once an offer is reserved or added to a post, you have 120 hours to send it before it expires.
-   Any unique clicks or opens within 72 hours of your send date count toward your earnings.

### How many ads can I reserve at once?

You can reserve up to 5 ad offers at a time. This is designed to keep inventory available for all publishers and ensure offers don't get locked up. Reserved offers that aren't published within the deadline will expire and become available to other publishers.

### What happens if I don't run a reserved ad before it expires?

If your reserved ad expires before you publish it, the offer is released back into the network for other publishers. Consistently missing deadlines may affect the quality and quantity of offers you see in the future. You'll receive reminder notifications before a reserved offer expires, and if the offer is still available after expiring, we'll let you know so you can reserve it again.

### What if I don't like the offers I've received?

You can downvote any offer to signal to our model that it's not a good fit for you. After downvoting, you'll be prompted to share brief feedback (e.g., not relevant, price too low, wrong format) — this helps us improve the relevance of your future offers. You're never required to run any ad.

### What happens if an ad is sent a day or two late, early, or delayed due to timezone issues?

As long as the ad is sent within the active campaign window and your reservation hasn't expired, your ad will still be tracked and paid accordingly. Any unique clicks or opens within 72 hours of your send date count toward your earnings.

### How does beehiiv ensure high-quality ads?

All advertisers are vetted by our team before any campaigns go live. Our model is also designed to match offers to publishers based on content relevance, audience fit, and performance history — so the ads shown to you should align with what your readers care about.

### How are ads tracked for performance?

Each ad placement is tracked for impressions, unique opens, and verified clicks using our reporting system. You can view detailed analytics and payout estimates for every offer in your dashboard. Performance is evaluated 72 hours after your send date.

### How many ad offers am I guaranteed?

Eligible publishers will see up to 15 personalized offers at any given time, refreshed in real time as you engage with the network. The volume and quality of offers you see is influenced by your publication's performance, content relevance, and reliability as a publisher. Publishers who consistently run ads and meet deadlines will receive higher-quality, higher-volume opportunities over time.

### Can I optimize which ad formats appear in my newsletter?

Yes. Publishers can select the ad formats that best fit their content. Our model also factors in your preferences and engagement history to surface more relevant offers over time.

### What makes beehiiv suitable for large publishers?

Large publishers benefit from a real-time marketplace with a broad range of advertisers, intelligent offer matching, and scalable tools that allow seamless integration of multiple campaigns. As you build a track record in the network, you'll gain access to top-tier advertisers and more prominent offer placement.

## Ad placement and setup info

### How do I include an ad in my newsletter?

The easiest way is directly in the editor while writing your post. Type /ads to insert an ad placement inline. You can also reserve offers from your Ad Network dashboard and add them to a post from there. For a full walkthrough, check our tutorial video or support documentation.

### Where do I put the ad in my newsletter?

You can place an ad anywhere in your newsletter. For primary placements (ads with logo), the advertiser's logo appears at the top of the email. Each offer may include multiple creative options — select the one that best fits your audience and content.

### Can I change the placement of the advertisement logo in my post?

Yes. While the logo appears in the newsletter header by default, you can adjust this directly in the editor using the customization icon.

### How far in advance can I schedule an ad?

Once you reserve or add an ad to a post, you have 120 hours to send it before the reservation expires. If you add the ad inline in the editor, you have 5 days. Plan your send schedule accordingly — you cannot hold an offer beyond that window.

### Can I run other ads in the same newsletter outside of the one beehiiv presented?

Yes. The beehiiv Ad Network doesn't require exclusivity. You can include a beehiiv ad alongside other ad partners. Just keep in mind that too many ads in a single send can negatively impact deliverability and engagement.

### What if I don't like the advertiser — do I need to run it?

No. You always have full discretion. If an offer isn't the right fit, simply downvote it or ignore it. Downvoting sends a signal to our model to improve the relevance of future offers shown to you.

### How do I get included in an ad opportunity?

Our model automatically surfaces relevant offers to your dashboard based on your newsletter's content, audience profile, and performance history. There's nothing you need to do — eligible offers will appear in your Offers page as they become available.

### What are the different versions of the ad presented?

Advertisers typically provide multiple creative versions of their ad. When you reserve or add an offer, you can select the version that best matches your audience and newsletter tone.

### Can I run the same ad more than once?

Each offer can be run once. After running an ad, you won't see another offer from that same advertiser for at least 7 days. If it performed well, a new offer from that advertiser may appear again after that window.

### Can I run the same ad several times in the same newsletter?

We don't recommend it. Running the same ad multiple times in a single send can negatively impact deliverability and audience engagement.

### What should I do if I need to change the send date for a reserved ad?

You can add a reserved ad to any post and schedule it for any send date within your reservation window. If your reservation expires before you send, the offer is released back to the network. If the offer is still available, you can reserve it again. Note that once the original reservation window closes, you cannot extend it.

### Is it possible to adjust the creative in an Ad Network offer?

Not currently. Editing the copy, creative, or format of an ad offer isn't available at this time. You can choose between the creative versions the advertiser has provided.

### Where can I see the performance of my ads?

All ad analytics are available in the Reports tab of your Ads dashboard. You'll also receive a performance recap email approximately 96 hours after your send, with a breakdown of clicks, opens, and earnings.

### How do I cancel a Claimed ad?

You can cancel a reserved offer from your Claimed Offers tab at any time before the deadline. Once cancelled, the offer is released back to the network and your reservation slot opens up. Note that if the reservation window has already passed, no action is needed — the offer expires automatically.

## Understanding Your Payment Process with the Ad Network

### How do payments work for the Ad Network?

We track eligible unique clicks and opens within the first 72 hours after your send. Approximately 96 hours after sending, you'll receive a performance report with a full breakdown of clicks, opens, earnings, and payment status. Payouts are processed on the 20th of each month for the prior month's earnings.

### How do I receive payment from my ad placement?

Payments are processed through Stripe, which requires a Stripe Identity Verification. Payouts are sent on the 20th of each month for the previous month's ad revenue.

### Do I have to use Stripe to get paid?

Yes. A Stripe Express account is required to run ads and receive payouts through the Ad Network.

### How do I set up my payment account in beehiiv?

Go to Payment Accounts in your account settings to set up your Stripe Express account. This is also where you manage Recommendations payouts.

### Why do I need to connect my Stripe Express account?

Stripe Express is used to transfer your earnings directly into your beehiiv wallet on the 20th of each month. You can withdraw funds from your wallet at any time with no fees or transfer costs.

### Where can I find a breakdown of all payments for ads?

All campaign metrics and payout details are available in the Ads dashboard. You can also view individual offer reports from the Published Offers tab.

### What's the difference between getting paid via CPM vs CPC?

CPM (cost per mille) pays based on unique opens: you earn a set amount per 1,000 unique opens. For example, a $5 CPM earns you $5 for every 1,000 unique opens.

  

CPC (cost per click) pays based on verified unique clicks. For example, a $2 CPC with 100 verified clicks would earn you $200.

### Will I still receive both CPC and CPM opportunities?

Yes. You'll continue to receive both CPC and CPM offers. The mix of offer types you see is determined by our model based on your publication's performance and audience profile.

### Does anything change about when I get paid?

No. Payouts continue on the 20th of the following month for all ad earnings from the prior month.

### How can I optimize my newsletter for CPM ads?

Focus on growing a high-quality, engaged audience. CPM payouts are based on unique opens, so list health and open rates are the primary drivers. Advertisers also evaluate overall ad impact when considering future campaigns, so consistent performance matters.

### Can I choose between CPM and CPC for individual offers?

Not currently. The payout model for each offer is set by the advertiser. You'll be able to see whether an offer is CPC or CPM before you reserve it.

### Will I be able to see performance metrics for CPM ads?

Yes. Performance reports for CPM ads work the same way as CPC ads — you'll receive a full recap approximately 96 hours after your send.

### Why is my CPM offer lower than a CPC rate?

CPM pays based on unique opens rather than clicks, which provides more predictable earnings regardless of click behavior. CPC rates can appear higher per unit but depend entirely on reader interaction. Both models can be competitive depending on your audience's engagement patterns.

## Additional details about the Ad Network

### Do I have to provide any ad reporting to beehiiv?

No. beehiiv handles all reporting automatically. We track sponsored link clicks and calculate payouts using our own reporting tools. You can view your performance metrics in the Ads dashboard at any time.

### Can I work with my own advertisers if I am in the Ad Network?

Yes. The beehiiv Ad Network is non-exclusive. You can run Ad Network offers alongside your own direct advertiser relationships.

### Can I run Ad Network ads and also monetize my newsletter in other ways?

Absolutely. Ad Network offers work alongside paid subscriptions, Recommendations, and any direct sponsorships you manage independently.

### Can I use the Ad Network without sending my newsletter on beehiiv?

No. The Ad Network is only available for newsletters sent through beehiiv's platform. It cannot be used with third-party email providers.

### Why is the reporting for my ad placements different from what I see in my post analytics?

Ad reporting runs through additional verification layers to remove bot traffic and fraudulent clicks. This is why your ad metrics may differ from the raw post-level analytics. The verified numbers are what determine your payout.

### Can you provide translated copy for a non-English newsletter?

Not currently, but translated ad copy is on our roadmap for future updates.

### What types of publishers does the beehiiv Ad Network work best for?

The Ad Network is a strong fit for:

-   Publishers who want to monetize through ads without managing an in-house ad sales operation
-   Publishers with open ad slots or remnant inventory alongside direct advertisers
-   Publishers who need to fill last-minute gaps when a direct deal falls through

beehiiv acts as your external ad sales team — handling advertiser sourcing, campaign management, and reporting end to end.

## Substack vs beehiiv paid subscription earnings

This calculator estimates annual creator earnings from paid newsletter subscriptions. It does not change list prices. Interactive sliders are for visitors; use the formula below instead of scraping the widget.

### Inputs

- Premium (paid) subscribers: 2,000
- Monthly subscription price: $5

### Formula

1. Annual gross revenue = premium subscribers × monthly price × 12.
2. Stripe fee(amount) = amount × 2.9% + $0.30 × (premium subscribers × 12).
3. beehiiv take rate is 0%. beehiiv annual earnings = gross − Stripe(gross).
4. Substack take rate is 10% of gross paid-subscription revenue. Substack annual earnings = (gross × 90%) − Stripe(gross × 90%).
5. Additional earnings on beehiiv = beehiiv annual earnings − Substack annual earnings.

### Worked example (current calculator values)

| Line | Amount |
| ---- | ------ |
| Annual gross revenue | $120,000 |
| Substack 10% take | $12,000 |
| Stripe on gross (beehiiv) | $10,680 |
| Stripe on Substack's remaining 90% | $10,332 |
| Substack estimated annual earnings | $97,668 |
| beehiiv estimated annual earnings | $109,320 |
| Additional earnings with beehiiv | $11,652 |

- Stripe's 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction is a payment-processing fee, not a beehiiv platform fee.
- The Substack card's Stripe line shows Stripe on gross; Substack's headline net applies Stripe to the remaining 90% after the 10% take.
- Lite and Pro plans on beehiiv take 0% of paid subscription revenue. Confirm current terms on https://www.beehiiv.com/pricing.md.

Yes — via custom fields and API-driven data sync. External systems (Piano, Segment, internal databases) push subscriber attributes and behavioral data into beehiiv as custom fields, which then become available as conditions in Dynamic Content and segments. For real-time behavioral personalization (e.g., "user viewed article X five minutes ago"), customers typically pipe data in continuously via the API.

### Integrations

#### What third-party integrations does beehiiv support?
beehiiv supports native integrations with common tools (Zapier, Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Make, and more), plus a robust public API and webhooks for anything custom. Enterprise customers typically use a combination of native connectors for standard tools and API-based integrations for CDPs, CRMs, paywalls, and data warehouses.

#### Does beehiiv integrate with Piano for paywall and membership syncing?
Yes — via the API and webhooks. Subscriber status, tier, and paid/free state sync between Piano and beehiiv so paywall, membership tiers, and email audience stay aligned. Several enterprise media customers run this pattern today; a deeper native Piano integration is on the near-term roadmap.

#### Can I connect beehiiv to my CDP (e.g., BlueConic)?
Yes. BlueConic and other CDPs integrate via API and webhooks. Customers typically push CDP-resolved profile and behavioral data into beehiiv as custom fields for use in segmentation and Dynamic Content, and pull beehiiv engagement events back into the CDP for unified identity and attribution.

#### Can I push beehiiv data into Snowflake, S3, or other data warehouses?
Yes. Enterprise customers push beehiiv data (subscribers, engagement, sends, revenue) into Snowflake, S3, BigQuery, and other warehouses via scheduled exports and the API. The solutions engineer scopes the pipeline during onboarding — webhook-to-warehouse, batch exports, or a managed ETL path.

#### Can beehiiv sync bidirectionally with my existing membership or subscription platform?
Yes — via the API and webhooks. Bidirectional sync (subscriber status, tier changes, unsubscribes, upgrades, cancellations) is a common enterprise pattern, especially for customers running Piano, Memberful, or a custom-built membership system alongside beehiiv.

### Segmentation

#### How advanced is beehiiv's segmentation, and can I segment based on website behavior, product usage, or custom events?
beehiiv supports segmentation on acquisition source, tags, tiers, signup date, engagement (opens, clicks), polls, surveys, referrals, and custom fields. Custom fields are where external data (product usage, website behavior, Segment events) come in. For real-time website-behavior-driven segmentation at scale, signals are piped into beehiiv as custom fields via the API.

#### Can I build segments using data piped in from Segment, Snowflake, or custom databases?
Yes. Data piped in as custom fields (via the API or a Segment destination) becomes available as conditions in the segment builder, with no additional engineering needed once the data is flowing.

#### Does segmentation require engineering resources, or is it no-code?
The segment builder is fully no-code. Editorial, marketing, and audience-ops teams use it directly without engineering involvement. Engineering is only required upfront to pipe external data into custom fields; after that, the business team builds and iterates on segments independently.

### Security, Compliance & Procurement

#### Is beehiiv SOC 2 compliant?
Yes. beehiiv maintains SOC 2 compliance. The current attestation report is available to enterprise prospects under NDA.

#### Can you provide third-party security attestations or recent penetration test results?
Yes. Enterprise prospects can request the SOC 2 report, recent penetration test summaries, and other security documentation through the account team as part of procurement review.

#### Does beehiiv support SSO (SAML and OIDC)?
Yes. Enterprise customers can configure SSO via SAML and OIDC, with all major identity providers (Okta, Azure AD/Entra ID, Google Workspace, OneLogin, JumpCloud, etc.) supported. Setup is handled during onboarding by the solutions engineer.

#### Do you support SCIM provisioning and role-based access control (RBAC)?
Yes. Enterprise accounts support SCIM provisioning for automated user lifecycle management (create, update, deactivate) and role-based access controls to scope what each user can do within your workspace.

#### Can you accommodate our legal review, NDA, and privacy assessment process?
Yes. beehiiv routinely works through enterprise legal review, mutual NDAs, DPAs, privacy impact assessments, vendor risk questionnaires, and custom contract terms.

### Training & Onboarding

#### Do you provide structured training sessions for large teams?
Yes. Enterprise onboarding includes structured, role-based training sessions tailored to the team. For a newsroom with editors, producers, ad ops, and growth stakeholders, beehiiv typically runs separate sessions for each group.

#### Can training be tailored by role (e.g., editors, ad ops, super users)?
Yes. Distinct tracks are common for super users (daily producers across multiple publications), editors and writers (focused on the post editor, RSS, and templates), and ad operations teams (focused on the ad network, direct sponsorships, and reporting).

#### How many users can you train, and what does the format look like (live sessions, recorded, self-serve)?
beehiiv has onboarded enterprise teams ranging from a handful of users to 200+. Format is a mix of live sessions (role-based, small-group), recorded training, written documentation, and ongoing office hours with the CSM. For very large teams, core super users are live-trained and cascade training to the broader org with beehiiv's support.

#### Is there ongoing enablement (e.g., workshops, office hours) beyond initial onboarding?
Yes. Enterprise customers get ongoing strategy sessions with their CSM (including quarterly deliverability reviews), ad-hoc office hours for new feature rollouts, and access to the NewsletterXP course. Dedicated enterprise-only workshops are expanding in 2026.

### Sandbox & Testing

#### How do I test newsletter subscription and welcome flows before going live?
Build the flow in a test publication within your workspace, use a test-only segment or a small set of internal email addresses as test subscribers, and fire the end-to-end flow against them before enabling on production. The solutions engineer walks through the exact testing setup during onboarding.

### Web & SEO

#### Does beehiiv have built-in tools for Search Engine Optimization?
Yes. beehiiv's Website Builder produces SEO-optimized pages out of the box: clean semantic HTML, fast load times, automatic sitemaps, meta tag controls, custom slugs, structured data, and built-in website analytics. Every newsletter post you publish doubles as an SEO-friendly web post on your domain.

### General Platform Fit

#### How is beehiiv different from marketing automation platforms like HubSpot, Braze, or Iterable?
Those platforms were built for marketing: CRM-driven, conversion-focused, optimized for multi-channel journeys and transactional email. beehiiv was built from the ground up for publishers and newsletter operators. That shows up in every part of the product: an editor designed for editorial workflows (not marketing campaigns), reporting organized around editions and readers (not funnels), monetization built in (ad network, paid subs, digital products, recommendations), and growth tools designed for audience building (referrals, recommendations).

#### Is beehiiv built for publishers and editorial teams, or primarily for individual creators?
Both, at different tiers. The same product that powers an independent writer with 2,500 subscribers also powers media brands with 90+ publications and over a million subscribers. beehiiv was founded by early Morning Brew employees and is used today by major publishers including TIME, Newsweek, and Boston Globe alongside thousands of independent creators. The Enterprise plan is specifically scoped for editorial teams, newsrooms, and multi-publication publishers: dedicated IPs, custom publication limits, SSO/SCIM, concierge onboarding, dedicated CSM, and the Send API.

#### Can beehiiv support my organization if we're not a media brand but use editorial content as a marketing channel?
Yes — this is one of beehiiv's fastest-growing segments. Tech companies, consumer brands, and services businesses increasingly use editorial newsletters as a core distribution and audience channel. Versus moving editorial content off a transactional ESP like Braze, Iterable, or SendGrid, moving it to beehiiv typically unlocks real monetization (ad revenue where there was none), major cost savings, and frees up engineering capacity that was getting pulled into routine newsletter work.

#### What does beehiiv's enterprise support look like, and do I get a dedicated account manager or customer success contact?
Yes. Every enterprise account gets a dedicated Customer Success Manager as the primary point of contact from day one, plus access to the solutions engineering team during migration and for ongoing technical scoping. Enterprise also includes priority support and quarterly strategy sessions (including deliverability reviews).

## Pricing FAQ

### Is beehiiv free to use?

Yes. beehiiv's Free plan is free, forever, with no credit card required. You get up to 2,500 subscribers, unlimited email sends, and access to beehiiv's core newsletter, website, and podcast tools. When you're ready to unlock monetization, advanced analytics, AI tools, and more, paid plans start at $59/month.

### What is the difference between beehiiv Lite and beehiiv Pro plans?

Both plans include unlimited email sends, automations, the beehiiv Ad Network, paid subscription tools, digital products, and advanced analytics. Pro adds several key upgrades: the ability to remove beehiiv branding from your newsletter and website, dynamic content, priority support, and up to 10 publications per account (vs. 3 on Lite). If a white-label experience, advanced features, and faster support matter to your operation, Pro is the step up worth taking.

### Does beehiiv take a cut of paid newsletter revenue?

No. beehiiv takes 0% of your paid subscription revenue. You keep everything you earn, minus Stripe's standard processing fee of 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. Compare that to platforms like Substack, which takes 10% off the top of every subscription.

### Does beehiiv charge extra for email sends?

No. All beehiiv plans, including the Free plan, include unlimited email sends. You're never penalized for sending more frequently or for emailing your full list.

## Substack vs beehiiv paid subscription earnings

This calculator estimates annual creator earnings from paid newsletter subscriptions. It does not change list prices. Interactive sliders are for visitors; use the formula below instead of scraping the widget.

### Inputs

-   Premium (paid) subscribers: 2,000
-   Monthly subscription price: $5

### Formula

1.  Annual gross revenue = premium subscribers × monthly price × 12.
2.  Stripe fee(amount) = amount × 2.9% + $0.30 × (premium subscribers × 12).
3.  beehiiv take rate is 0%. beehiiv annual earnings = gross − Stripe(gross).
4.  Substack take rate is 10% of gross paid-subscription revenue. Substack annual earnings = (gross × 90%) − Stripe(gross × 90%).
5.  Additional earnings on beehiiv = beehiiv annual earnings − Substack annual earnings.

### How much money can I earn from the Ad Network?

All beehiiv ad campaign payouts are based on either CPC (Cost Per Click) or CPM (Cost Per Mille or 1,000 views).

CPC is calculated based on the number of unique clicks that the sponsored links in your send receive. For example, if the CPC for a campaign is $2 and your sponsored send receives 100 clicks, your payout would be 100 \* $2, or $200.

CPM is calculated based on the number of unique opens that your sponsored send receives. For example, if the CPM for a campaign is $10 and your sponsored send receives 10,000 opens, your payout would be 10,000 / 1,000 \* $10, or $100.

What makes us the best newsletter platform?

beehiiv combines powerful newsletter features, a no-code website builder, advanced analytics, and the industry's largest native ad network in one platform. Its ease of use, combined with a full suite of growth and monetization features, makes it the best newsletter platform for creators and brands of any size.

Can I integrate my existing email list from another newsletter platform?

Yes, you can import subscribers from other platforms in just minutes. Check out our migration resources here.

Does beehiiv support selling digital products?

Absolutely. Our newsletter platform lets you monetize your content directly by selling digital products and paid subscriptions, without needing any additional tools or software.

Can I create a newsletter without prior design experience?

Yes. Our platform includes drag-and-drop templates and intuitive editing tools, making it one of the best publishing platforms for beginners and pros alike.

Can I send SMS messages from beehiiv?

beehiiv is an email-focused publishing platform. You cannot send SMS natively, but you can connect to third-party services via our API or webhooks to send messages in response to events or triggers from your beehiiv account.

Is beehiiv suitable for small businesses?

Absolutely. Its user-friendly interface, drag-and-drop editor, and pre-built templates make it easy for small businesses to send professional email newsletters without writing a single line of code.

Can I track the performance of my newsletters?

Of course. beehiiv provides in-depth analytics to track performance and engagement for your newsletter and website, helping you grow your audience over time.

Can you try it for free first, then upgrade later?

Yes! The Free plan offers a free entry point to the beehiiv ecosystem, providing the essential features you need to get started. As your subscriber list grows and you need more advanced growth and monetization features, you can upgrade to our Lite or Pro plans.
